confirmed_user_requirement: Continuous front wall; gate enters from rear and closes inside front landing.

hopper.status: normal_thickness_geometry_proposal; weld shrinkage / end bevel / holes / flow require mockup

body.front_pocket: Front edge enters landing under upper seat; limit stops motion, no impact against wall.
body.welding: PP fixed body welds into a U enclosure, gate withdraws from rear. POM is an alternative bolted architecture, not a weld-in substitute.

brush.placement: Front and rear of five short inlet lanes ABOVE gate; not inside the 10mm lower outlet throat.
brush.carrier_screw: M2x12 candidate, 12 used + 4 spare; thickness / blind inserts verify
brush.retention: Supplier tufted, sealed cut ends; removable clamp and PP outer guard. No exposed glue or hand-glued loose fibres.
brush.uncertainty: Initial fit geometry. Bristle spread, preload, bean passage, retention and cleanability need sample tests.

power.fuse_note: Preliminary DC wire protection, not servo jam protection; test inrush and actual holder rating.
power.adapter: YU2405, user selected24V5A120W; exact maker, plug, polarity and supplied AC lead not verified
power.buck: 5V logic TPS5450 board candidate; 6V servo HOBBYWING UBEC5A 30607000 / 2-8S, selected6V
power.terminal: Delixi TB-1506 / DHATB1506N x2; two matching 3-pole bridges only on TB-A
power.common_reference: Nonisolated bucks; each load returns to its own output. No extra output-ground jumpers.
power.box_layout_status: Procurement envelope, not complete mechanical interference approval
power.candidate_preference: 5V logic: TPS5450 board candidate. 6V servo: user selected UBEC 5A / 6V; proposed exact model HOBBYWING 30607000 2-8S.
power.logic_buck: TPS5450DDA-based 5V complete board candidate; needs exact maker/SKU and 24V to 5V 4A thermal evidence
power.servo_buck: HOBBYWING UBEC 5A, 30607000, 2-8S version, 6.0V jumper selected; factory 5A rating, system wiring / transient testing pending
power.previous_xl4016: Low cost alternative retained; no unsupported claim that all TPS5450 boards outperform all XL4016 boards
power.servo_voltage_setting: 6.0V jumper; disconnect power before setting, meter before servo connection
power.protection_note: TI chip OVP turns high-side FET off during overshoot; not a separate disconnect against a shorted pass switch.
power.safety: Nonisolated. Reverse polarity / output fault containment depend on full board and external protection. Fuses not servo jam protection.

mounting.bracket_raw: 6061 angle25x25x2, cut width20, vertical leg22 / horizontal leg14
mounting.load_path: Hopper -> PP welds -> PP3 rim -> four supports -> black2020. Lower fixed feed body also locates on G21/G11; align without pulling the weldment out of plane.
mounting.note: PP3 creep, weld pull-out and single-screw bracket rotation not yet proof-loaded. No wood hopper load support.

retained: V4.8 frame, nine wood panels, screens; V4.9 main four hopper panels and electrical topology retained.
unresolved: G10 ball head ear and full rear moving envelope / hood G20 need physical sweep mockup

PP weld distortion and sliding friction, short brush segments / outer guards / carrier exact holes need samples
Power full board SKU / temperature / ripple / startup / peak response not validated
